X-37

This is the first flying version of a paper model. It was originally designed in 1/48 scale and can be found at Ecardmodels. I made the flying version 200% or approximately 1/24 scale. The 1/48 card model was done very nice but as it was scaled up, I started to notice some scale discrepancies. I am doing some re-work to make the larger one more scale and more appropriate for a flying model.  Stay tuned….

 

This is the X40 built on another page, the X-37built here, and the original 1/48 X-37 paper model available from Ecardmodels.
